brainlife.desc: Experimental: voxel-wise Regional Homogeneity (ReHo) map of BOLD fMRI as a single z-scored NIfTI volume.
brainlife.name: neuro/reho

original.readme:
This datatype allows single-volume Nifti files containing the result of Region Homogeneity analyses.

Zang, Y., Jiang, T., Lu, Y., He, Y., Tian, L., 2004. Regional homogeneity approach to fMRI data analysis. Neuroimage 22, 394-400.

brainlife.readme:
This datatype allows single-volume Nifti files containing the result of Region Homogeneity analyses.

Zang, Y., Jiang, T., Lu, Y., He, Y., Tian, L., 2004. Regional homogeneity approach to fMRI data analysis. Neuroimage 22, 394-400.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.reho.json

governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers.
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when used to predict traits or states of a person

not_suitable_for: Comparison across studies with different smoothing or neighbourhood settings.
